subject: Emergency fallback activation — smoke test and quick verification
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Levin <sarah@arkai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Emergency fallback activation — smoke test and quick verification

Hi Sarah —

Quick heads up: we detected a correctness/regression signal for long-context requests in the inference scheduler that started ~08:40 PST. To keep ArkAI apps healthy while the engineering team validates a targeted hotfix, we activated an automatic fallback policy for your account that routes long-sequence requests to the verified L2-compat model (latency ~+20ms).

We need ArkAI to run a very brief smoke test so we can confirm end-to-end behavior on your side before we flip traffic back to the optimized path. Attached is a small smoke_test.sh and a verification checklist with expected outputs. Steps: 

1) Pull the attached smoke_test.sh and run on a representative request set (examples in checklist).
2) Share the result summary (pass/fail) and any unexpected tokens or truncation artifacts.
3) If you see degraded semantics, include the request id(s) from the attached logs you sent earlier.

Target timeline: if you can run the checks within 30–60 minutes we can proceed with the rollback test in a controlled canary. If all good, we plan a staged revert starting at 10:45 PST.

We’ll keep this thread as the single source of truth. Internal ops: Marissa, Karthik — please keep logging verbose for ArkAI for the next 2 hours and hold the hotfix rollout until we have ArkAI’s smoke results.

Apologies for the short notice — we wanted to minimize customer impact and keep you in the loop.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

Attachments: smoke_test.sh (bash), verification-checklist.md

Subject: Re: Emergency fallback activation — smoke test and quick verification

Thanks Ben — we saw the fallback hit earlier this morning. Ops will run the smoke tests now (we have a short regression suite that targets the 8K+ context requests).

I ran a quick spot-check against two production requests and attached a small log bundle (arkai_request_logs.tar.gz) — no obvious truncation but one request had an unexpectedly higher repetition score. We’ll run the full smoke_test.sh in ~20 minutes and post results here.

On the rollback: we prefer you keep the fallback active until we validate; if the rollback introduces token mismatch we’ll need rollback again. Please keep verbose telemetry for the two request ids I attached.

—Sarah

Ben / Karthik —

Ops update: we confirmed elevated divergence metric on sequences >6k tokens around 08:38 PST. Hotfix branch (schedfix-4821) contains a guard to avoid a KV-index edge-case; we’re running unit + integration tests now.

Per Ben’s ask, I increased request-level logging for ArkAI (kept only for 2 hours) and kicked off a canary with 5% traffic to the L2-compat model where the fallback already routes. If ArkAI smoke is green we can do a staged revert.

Karthik — please hold the warm rollback until ArkAI ack. If they see issues, we’ll keep fallback and push the hotfix after one more safety run.

Marissa

Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Emergency fallback activation — smoke test and quick verification

Sarah —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. ArkAI’s smoke results came back green (see the summary below). Based on that we ran the staged revert with a 10% canary at 11:40 PST and monitored token-level diffs and latency for 30 minutes. No regressions observed. We rolled to 100% at 11:55 PST.

Summary:
- Smoke: PASS (3/3 representative requests matched expected output within acceptance thresholds)
- Observability: no spike in 4xx/5xx, latency within expected range (+18ms median)
- Action: rolled revert to optimized scheduler path at 11:55 PST

Next steps: we’ll publish a short postmortem and the hotfix change details to the incident folder by EOD. I’ve provisioned a small customer goodwill credit for ArkAI; Marissa is looping finance to apply it.

Postmortem link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/pm-incident-2026-11-21-arkai
Jira: HB-4821

If you notice any residual issues, please reply here and we’ll re-open investigation.

Thanks again for the speedy validation — sorry for the interruption.

Ben
